_comment: Procress 32 9.0 — the 3-way merge cases both apps' engines are held to (EXE src/db/portlink-merge.js, APK portlink_merge.dart). Per case: three databases from the vault DDL; `seed` runs on all three (it is the base B); then `local` runs on L (this machine) and `drive` on D (the drive); the merge is run as mergeInto(B, L, W = D) with `choices`. `expect.ok` true = every `expect.queries[i].sql` on W returns exactly `rows`; `expect.code` 'needs_choice' = the conflict keys are exactly `expect.conflicts` and nothing was written. Ids in queries are never assumed for rows made after the seed: both sides get max+1, which is the point. See fixtures/README.md.
seed: INSERT INTO module (id, nexus_ref, name, kind) VALUES (10, 1, 'Heroes', 'classifier')
INSERT INTO classifier_object (id, module_ref, name) VALUES (100, 10, 'A')

cases.name: owner-example
cases.why: The owner's own example: A renamed to B on the drive while this machine made C → B and C.
local: INSERT INTO classifier_object (module_ref, name) VALUES (10, 'C')
drive: UPDATE classifier_object SET name='B' WHERE id=100

queries.sql: SELECT name FROM classifier_object ORDER BY name

cases.name: nothing-changed
cases.why: No edits anywhere: the result is the base.

queries.sql: SELECT name FROM classifier_object

cases.name: different-columns
cases.why: Both sides edited the same row but different columns: both edits kept, no question.
local: UPDATE classifier_object SET name='Ann' WHERE id=100
drive: UPDATE classifier_object SET note='from the drive' WHERE id=100

queries.sql: SELECT name, note FROM classifier_object

cases.name: same-column-asks
cases.why: Both sides set the same column to different values: a conflict, and nothing is decided for the user.
local: UPDATE classifier_object SET name='Local' WHERE id=100
drive: UPDATE classifier_object SET name='Drive' WHERE id=100

cases.name: same-column-chosen
cases.why: The same conflict, answered: the chosen side's value.
local: UPDATE classifier_object SET name='Local' WHERE id=100
drive: UPDATE classifier_object SET name='Drive' WHERE id=100

queries.sql: SELECT name FROM classifier_object

cases.name: same-value-both
cases.why: Both sides made the same change: not a conflict.
local: UPDATE classifier_object SET name='Same' WHERE id=100
drive: UPDATE classifier_object SET name='Same' WHERE id=100

queries.sql: SELECT name FROM classifier_object

cases.name: edit-beats-delete
cases.why: Deleted on one side, edited on the other: kept, with the edit. A delete of something the other side left alone goes through.

INSERT INTO classifier_object (id, module_ref, name) VALUES (102, 10, 'Y')
INSERT INTO classifier_object (id, module_ref, name) VALUES (103, 10, 'Z')
local: DELETE FROM classifier_object WHERE id=101
UPDATE classifier_object SET note='local note' WHERE id=102
DELETE FROM classifier_object WHERE id=103
drive: UPDATE classifier_object SET note='drive note' WHERE id=101

queries.sql: SELECT name, note FROM classifier_object WHERE id<>100 ORDER BY name

cases.name: new-ids-collide
cases.why: Both sides made a row with the same next id: the drive's keeps it, this machine's is renumbered, and an entity key pointing at it follows.
local: INSERT INTO classifier_object (module_ref, name) VALUES (10, 'P')
INSERT INTO entity_relation (nexus_ref, from_key, to_key, label) VALUES (1, 'cobj_' || (SELECT id FROM classifier_object WHERE name='P'), 'cobj_100', 'P knows A')

queries.sql: SELECT name FROM classifier_object ORDER BY name
SELECT (SELECT id FROM classifier_object WHERE name='Q') = 101 AS drive_kept_id
SELECT from_key = 'cobj_' || (SELECT id FROM classifier_object WHERE name='P') AS follows, to_key FROM entity_relation WHERE label='P knows A'

cases.name: id-refs-follow
cases.why: Every idRefs shape follows a renumbered row: nexus_history.module_ref (id), module_ui pageHead: (prefixedKey), mapModule (id as text), clsRelInclude (jsonIdList), exhibit_node.props (jsonObjectIdLists).
seedExtra: INSERT INTO module (id, nexus_ref, name, kind) VALUES (20, 1, 'Board', 'exhibitor')
local: INSERT INTO module (nexus_ref, name, kind) VALUES (1, 'Local mod', 'classifier')
INSERT INTO classifier_object (module_ref, name) VALUES (10, 'Local obj')
INSERT INTO classifier_template (module_ref, description) VALUES (10, 'Local field')
INSERT INTO nexus_history (nexus_ref, seq, action, module_ref, module_name) VALUES (1, 1, 'create', (SELECT id FROM module WHERE name='Local mod'), 'Local mod')
INSERT INTO module_ui (module_ref, ui_key, ui_value) VALUES (10, 'pageHead:cobj_' || (SELECT id FROM classifier_object WHERE name='Local obj'), '{}')
INSERT INTO module_ui (module_ref, ui_key, ui_value) VALUES (10, 'mapModule', CAST((SELECT id FROM module WHERE name='Local mod') AS TEXT))
INSERT INTO module_ui (module_ref, ui_key, ui_value) VALUES (10, 'clsRelInclude', '[' || (SELECT id FROM module WHERE name='Local mod') || ']')
INSERT INTO exhibit_node (module_ref, props) VALUES (20, '{"fields":[' || (SELECT id FROM classifier_template WHERE description='Local field') || ']}')
drive: INSERT INTO module (nexus_ref, name, kind) VALUES (1, 'Drive mod', 'classifier')
INSERT INTO classifier_object (module_ref, name) VALUES (10, 'Drive obj')
INSERT INTO classifier_template (module_ref, description) VALUES (10, 'Drive field')

queries.sql: SELECT module_ref = (SELECT id FROM module WHERE name='Local mod') AS ok FROM nexus_history WHERE module_name='Local mod'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM module_ui WHERE ui_key = 'pageHead:cobj_' || (SELECT id FROM classifier_object WHERE name='Local obj')
SELECT ui_value = CAST((SELECT id FROM module WHERE name='Local mod') AS TEXT) AS ok FROM module_ui WHERE ui_key='mapModule'
SELECT ui_value = '[' || (SELECT id FROM module WHERE name='Local mod') || ']' AS ok FROM module_ui WHERE ui_key='clsRelInclude'
SELECT props = '{"fields":[' || (SELECT id FROM classifier_template WHERE description='Local field') || ']}' AS ok FROM exhibit_node

cases.name: drive-ref-stays
cases.why: Both sides made a module (same next id, so this machine's is renumbered); the drive moved A into its module while this machine only renamed A. A renumber moves only what this machine wrote: A stays in the drive's module.
local: INSERT INTO module (nexus_ref, name, kind) VALUES (1, 'Local mod', 'classifier')
UPDATE classifier_object SET name='A2' WHERE id=100
drive: INSERT INTO module (nexus_ref, name, kind) VALUES (1, 'Drive mod', 'classifier')
UPDATE classifier_object SET module_ref=(SELECT id FROM module WHERE name='Drive mod') WHERE id=100

queries.sql: SELECT o.name, m.name AS mod FROM classifier_object o JOIN module m ON m.id=o.module_ref
SELECT name FROM module ORDER BY name

cases.name: same-tag-both
cases.why: Both sides made the tag 'fire' (UNIQUE tag_name): one tag, and the join rows of both sides point at it.
seedExtra: INSERT INTO module (id, nexus_ref, name, kind) VALUES (11, 1, 'Places', 'classifier')
local: INSERT INTO hashtag (tag_name) VALUES ('fire')
INSERT INTO module_hashtag (module_ref, hashtag_id) VALUES (11, (SELECT id FROM hashtag WHERE tag_name='fire'))
drive: INSERT INTO module_hashtag (module_ref, hashtag_id) VALUES (10, (SELECT id FROM hashtag WHERE tag_name='fire'))

queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM hashtag
SELECT m.name FROM module_hashtag mh JOIN module m ON m.id=mh.module_ref JOIN hashtag h ON h.id=mh.hashtag_id WHERE h.tag_name='fire' ORDER BY m.name

cases.name: join-removed-here
cases.why: A join row removed on this machine is removed; one the drive added stays.
local: DELETE FROM module_hashtag WHERE module_ref=10 AND hashtag_id=5

queries.sql: SELECT hashtag_id FROM module_hashtag ORDER BY hashtag_id

cases.name: parent-comes-back
cases.why: The drive deleted a module this machine added to: the module comes back, with both sides' content, and no row is left pointing nowhere.
local: INSERT INTO classifier_object (module_ref, name) VALUES (10, 'New here')

queries.sql: SELECT name FROM module
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM classifier_object WHERE name='New here'
